question: Why is generative-design software used in launch vehicle (LV) structural engineering?

options.text: To increase the mass of structural components
To reduce structural weight while maintaining performance
To simplify 2D CAD drafting in mission drawings
To boost overall mission cost through advanced algorithms

solution:
The correct answer is __**To reduce structural weight while maintaining performance**__.
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__
 
 
 
• **Generative-design software** is extensively used in launch vehicle (LV) structural engineering to **reduce the structural weight** of components while ensuring that they meet the required **performance, strength, and safety standards**. 
 
• It utilizes advanced **algorithms and artificial intelligence** to explore a wide range of design possibilities, aiming to identify the most **efficient and lightweight structures**. 
 
• This software can **simulate and analyze stress, load distribution, and other mechanical properties** of a structure to ensure that it can withstand extreme conditions during launch and space travel.
